messages:
anya: Proposal: add a streaming "warmup" advisory header so edge can signal a small prefetch window (ms) clients may opt to account for. Could reduce hedging. Thoughts?

kyle: header name?

anya: `X-RI-Stream-Warmup: 100` (ms). Sent on initial 101/early headers for streaming. advisory only.

ravi: ops: clamp to per-tenant budget, don't let it be abused. Also ensure accounting for SLOs.

liz: runtime: we can emit when we actually prefetch KV/batching. Need idempotent warmup actions.

kyle: clients need simple SDK snippet. Also limit to HTTP/2 & chunked streaming; otherwise send `X-RI-Stream-Warmup: 0`.

anya: suggested canary: 2% streaming traffic, flag `edge-warmup-v1`. metrics: hedging rate, p50/p95 latency, prefetch QPS.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started `edge-warmup-v1` by anya — build 7910

ravi: security note: warmup tag must be tenant-scoped and not leak routing. billing: chargeable prefetch budget for Dedicated customers.

anya: will add RFC blurb + SDK example: ```resp = client.start_stream(); if h := resp.headers.get('X-RI-Stream-Warmup'): client.deadline += int(h)/1000```
